page_summary: This page contains survey questions regarding cybersecurity practices and external engagement for organizations. It includes inquiries about incident response drills, experiences with cybersecurity incidents, compliance with regulations, notification requirements for cyber incident response teams, and participation in information-sharing mechanisms. The questions are structured with multiple-choice answers, allowing respondents to indicate their level of compliance or engagement.

regions.label: Survey Questions
regions.description: Survey questions related to cybersecurity incident response, regulations, and information-sharing mechanisms.
